decision_notes: Official assembly webcasts designate Public Accounts recordings for 1 and 2 October 2026. Both decode in Chromium and WebKit. The first 1 October sample shows a listener; a later 3600-second sample confirms a participant speaking at a lit committee microphone. The 2 October sample shows a separate participant speaking. Original, English and French interpretation selectors are present; only default playback was tested, muted. Plenary and current live coverage remain unverified.

The assembly disclaimer permits specified educational, private-study, research and reporting reproduction with accuracy and unofficial-version conditions. Its precise applicability to independent redistribution of the webcast remains unestablished; permission stays pending for that use.
